_comment: EXPECTED TO DIFFER PER SITE. The budgets tests/page-weight.spec.ts checks (decoded kilobytes).
Start from what the site weighs today plus about 25%, then tighten: a budget set far above
reality never fails. Keys left out fall back to the spec's own numbers.
A route that must be heavy gets its own entry under pages, with the reason in _why.
jsonLd lists the schema.org types a route must carry, e.g. { "/": ["Organization"] }.

Auburn (2026-10-27): measured on the snapshot build plus about 25 percent. HTML and inline CSS are large on purpose: each page carries its own purged CSS inline (scripts/purge-page-css.mjs), 97 to 122 KB.

/contact/._why: The form island loads React and the form libraries (283 KB decoded when measured, 2026-10-27).
